english.title: Conspire to sell / supply / offer to sell / supply medicinal product to general sale elsewhere than at from reg pharmacy

(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 221 and 255(6)(a) and (7) of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 339(1) of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012 provides that a magistrates' court in England or Wales may try an information for an offence under these Regulations that is triable only summarily if the information was laid at any time within the period of twelve months beginning with the commission of the offence.
(ii) This offence applies from the 1st October 2025 due to changes made by SI 2025/758 Human Medicines (Amendments Relating to Hub and Spoke Dispensing etc.) Regulations 2025. For the offence applying before this date, see H4104.

other.penalty:
Indictment: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months - see regulation 339(1)
